name: Werkstatt:München
production_model: Handmade in its own Munich atelier

prices.note: All Rings collection: 101 products, 1 non-ring excluded, 100 regular, none marked down. Silver from €175 (ring classic round forged) to €20,250 (4 ring combination hammered gold). EUR store; USD at ECB 2026-10-28. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price (Shopify products.json, the test product-images.mjs uses); price-zero items excluded.

notes: History: founded 1996 in Munich by Klaus Lohmeyer, a master gold and silversmith; jewelry 'handmade in Munich, Germany' in its own atelier; recycled metals, no chemical coatings, no plated pieces.

Shipping: country selector includes Australia, Canada, UK, US; priority shipping outside Europe/Asia €43, US 2-6 business days; US duties and import taxes charged on delivery to the recipient ('Every shipment to the United States is subject to import charges, whatever its value'). No free-shipping threshold.
Returns: 14-day withdrawal; from outside the EU a flat €50 return label and customs fee is deducted and import duties aren't refunded; made-to-order pieces excluded.

Sizes: XXS 49, XS 52, S 54, M 60, L 65, XL 68 (French sizes). Named rings: ring classic round forged €175 (hammered with a polished silversmith hammer), cross ring forged €385 (forged from a rectangular silver profile, winds round the finger twice).
